Hello Nomsa Dlamini. This is your payslip for 01 Sept 2026 – 30 Sept 2026, paid on 25 September 2026.
You earned R 29,979.96 before deductions. After R 7,829.32 in deductions, your net pay is R 22,150.64.
Compared with your last pay, net pay is down R 365.02. The biggest movement: Overtime at 1.5 times, -R 493.32.
Your employer also contributed R 5,119.42 towards benefits and contributions this period.
Keep this payslip, or select any line to ask about it or log a query. Your Annual leave balance is now 11.75 days.
Hallo Nomsa Dlamini. Dit is u salarisstrokie vir 1 Sep. 2026 – 30 Sep. 2026, betaal op 25 September 2026.
U het R 29 979,96 voor aftrekkings verdien. Ná R 7 829,32 aan aftrekkings is u netto salaris R 22 150,64.
In vergelyking met u vorige salaris is die netto salaris R 365,02 laer. Die grootste beweging: Oortyd teen 1,5 keer, -R 493,32.
U werkgewer het hierdie periode ook R 5 119,42 tot voordele en bydraes bygedra.
Bewaar hierdie salarisstrokie, of kies enige lyn om daaroor te vra of ’n navraag in te dien. U saldo vir Jaarlikse verlof is nou 11,75 dae.
Sawubona Nomsa Dlamini. Lesi yisitatimende sakho se-Sep 1, 2026 – Sep 30, 2026, esikhokhwe mhlaka September 25, 2026.
Uhole u-R 29,979.96 ngaphambi kwezimali ezidonswayo. Ngemva kwezimali ezidonswayo ezingu-R 7,829.32, umholo wakho osele ngu-R 22,150.64.
Uma uqhathaniswa nomholo wakho wokugcina, umholo osele wehle ngo-R 365.02. Ushintsho olukhulu kunazo zonke: I-ovathayimu ephindwe ka-1.5, -R 493.32.
Umqashi wakho naye unikele ngo-R 5,119.42 ezinzuzweni naseminikelweni kulesi sikhathi.
Gcina lesi sitatimende, noma ukhethe noma yimuphi umugqa ukuze ubuze ngawo noma ufake umbuzo. Ibhalansi yakho (Ikhefu lonyaka) manje ingu-11.75 izinsuku.
Molo Nomsa Dlamini. Eli liphepha lomvuzo wakho lexesha elithi Sep 1, 2026 – Sep 30, 2026, elihlawulwe nge-September 25, 2026.
Usebenzele i-R 29,979.96 ngaphambi kokutsalwa kweemali. Emva kweemali ezitsalwayo ezingu-R 7,829.32, umvuzo wakho osalayo ngu-R 22,150.64.
Xa kuthelekiswa nomvuzo wakho wokugqibela, umvuzo osalayo wehle nge-R 365.02. Intshukumo enkulu: I-ovathayim ephindwe ka-1.5, -R 493.32.
Umqeshi wakho naye ufake i-R 5,119.42 kwizibonelelo namagalelo kweli xesha.
Gcina eli phepha lomvuzo, okanye khetha nawuphi na umgca ukuze ubuze ngawo okanye ufake umbuzo. Ibhalansi yakho (Ikhefu lonyaka) ngoku ngu-11.75 iintsuku.
